stations.title: Bridie
stations.note: The office takes three calls at once.

stations.title: Old program
stations.text: Rings the office one booking at a time

stations.title: Harbour office
stations.say: Three at a time, all confirmed.

captions: Morning at the hut. The harbour office sends Bridie the day's bookings to confirm.
The old program confirms them one at a time, and the boat fills while she waits.
You hand the bookings to a pool of three threads and read each answer from its future.
Three calls at a time, the bookings are confirmed, and a failed one is reported.
Bridie's bookings are confirmed in a third of the time, with every failure named.
